xilinx.Synth 8-7080: Small blocks do not meet the heuristic for parallel synthesis; sequential synthesis is complete.

Netlist 29-101.reason: Floorplanning advisory for inferred DSP datapaths; place/route and timing remain mandatory.
Netlist 29-101.pattern: ^WARNING: \[Netlist 29-101\] Netlist 'rtl_synth_top' is not ideal for floorplanning, since the cellview 'bpsk_[a-z_]+' contains a large number of primitives\.  Please consider enabling hierarchy in synthesis if you want to do floorplanning\.$

Synth 8-3936.reason: Known width trimming of sign extension, constant unity gain, partial-product and acquisition fit-term registers (only the low 48 bits reach the 32-bit phase and residual). Numeric equivalence is independently checked.
Synth 8-3936.pattern: ^WARNING: \[Synth 8-3936\] Found unconnected internal register '(?:gained_(?:re|im)_reg|gain_pipe_reg\[[0-3]\]|intercept_reg|phase_mean_reg|score_offset_reg|(?:g_timing\.)?inverse_product_reg|gain_product_reg)' and it is trimmed from '\d+' to '\d+' bits\. \[.*/bpsk_(?:rotate|acquire|track)\.sv:\d+\]$

Synth 8-3332.reason: DSP absorption of known arithmetic pipeline registers; no control/valid registers may be removed. fxp_mrc2: the weight multiplier output register is absorbed into the cascaded DSP P registers. QAM16: the gain-error reciprocal product register is absorbed the same way.
Synth 8-3332.pattern: ^WARNING: \[Synth 8-3332\] Sequential element \((?:gained_(?:re|im)_reg__\d+|(?:g_timing\.)?timing_normalized_reg\[\d+\](?:__\d+)?|g_qam16_decision\.gain_scaled_reg\[\d+\]|g_bpsk_tx\.dut/(?:g_[bq]psk\.)?filter/(?:real_axis/|g_complex\.imag_axis/)?sum2(?:_re)?_reg\[4\]\[-\d+\]|(?:g_mrc\.dut/)?product_q_reg\[\d+\])\) is unused and will be removed from module (?:bpsk_rotate(?:__\d+)?|bpsk_track|fxp_mrc2|rtl_synth_top)\.$

Synth 8-7129.reason: Optional imaginary input is unused only in the real-only BPSK transmitter filter variant.
Synth 8-7129.pattern: ^WARNING: \[Synth 8-7129\] Port s_im\[(?:[0-9]|1[0-7])\] in module bpsk_fir is either unconnected or has no load$

altera.10335: Foreign synthesis attributes are ignored; Quartus uses its own inference and IO packing hints.

10030.reason: Read-only inferred M10K exposes unused write data/address/enable ports. Quartus ties them to zero; only these three internal ROM ports are permitted (a one-bit ROM address, as in the 4-point FFT twiddle ROM, names the port with its bit index).
10030.pattern: ^Warning \(10030\): Net "memory\.(data_a|waddr_a|we_a)(?:\[\d+\])?" at sync_rom\.sv\(\d+\) has no driver or initial value, using a default initial value '0'(?: File: .*/sync_rom\.sv Line: \d+)?$

10036.reason: Intentional ignored phase fraction, padded metadata and optional diagnostic outputs in the BPSK pilot; no other unused object is accepted.
10036.pattern: ^Warning \(10036\): Verilog HDL or VHDL warning at bpsk_(?:fir|acquire|track|rx)\.sv\(\d+\): object "unused_(?:im|gain_rotation_phase|angle_tag|rotated_tag|divider_busy|acquisition_busy|tracking_busy|position_fraction)" assigned a value but never read(?: File: .* Line: \d+)?$
